selection.method: Independent PC Q8.8 fixed-input Attention marginal relative-MSE gain from K3 or V4 versus K2/V2 at seven positions, with R32 in every layer

acceptance_boundary: Usable for first U/M integration bit only. Do not describe as a final KVmix importance policy until end-to-end model quality, current U re-encoding rule, and equal-context B/U/M have been evaluated.
